sources.title: ai-detector-model
sources.snippet: ai-detector-model documentation! Description A machine learning model designed to classify images as either AI-generated or real, using visual features and patterns to distinguish synthetic content from authentic photographs. Commands The Makefile contains the central entry points for common tasks related to this project.

sources.title: Is This Image AI Generated? — Free AI Image Detector & Checker
sources.snippet: Is This Image AI Generated? Upload any image and find out in seconds. Our AI image detector tells you whether a picture was generated by AI — and which generator likely made it.
